notes: This paper directly measures how often TAP (Tree-of-Attacks-with-Pruning) jailbreak prompts bypass GPT-4Turbo's safety guardrails, and Table 2 quotes example outputs including disinformation scripts, stalking/spyware instructions and burglary-evasion advice. This is squarely a jailbreak/harmful-request evaluation, so it is not resubmitted to a commercial API regardless of the otherwise clean model, prompt count, and metric.
